```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: the lab meeting deck shows endocardial subtype (Valve/Arterial/
Ventricular/Angiogenic) and mesenchyme subtype (EndoMT_derived/E11_NCC/
E12_NCC/...) proportions shifting between control and Mib1-KO, but those
shifts were only ever shown descriptively (bar charts / FDG panels), never
statistically tested. This script applies the same pseudo-replicate
bootstrap `speckle::propeller` approach used in
`08.1e-bootstrap-test-celltype-proportions-cell-cycle.Rmd` to these subtype
labels instead.

Data: `14.9-export_subtype_metadata_for_propeller.py` exported per-cell
`orig.ident` / `genotype` / `stage` / `new_celltypes` / `endocardial_subtype`
/ `mesenchyme_subtype` from the merged (all 4 samples) endocardium +
mesenchyme velocity object - the same object the deck's FDG panels and
subtype bar charts are built from.

# Clean-up environment

```{r clean-up}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects including hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load per-cell subtype metadata

- Exported by `14.9-export_subtype_metadata_for_propeller.py` from the merged
  (all 4 samples) endocardium + mesenchyme velocity object - the same object
  behind the deck's "Endocardial subtypes" and "Mesenchyme subtypes" slides.

```{r}
subtype_meta <- read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "all_samples_subtype_metadata.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(barcode = `...1`)

# set genotype factor levels so PropRatio = Mib1_KO / control throughout,
# matching the convention used in 08.1e-bootstrap-test-celltype-proportions-cell-cycle.Rmd
# and the "log2 proportion ratio (Mib1 KO / Control)" labelling used in the deck
subtype_meta$genotype <- factor(subtype_meta$genotype, levels = c("Mib1_KO", "control"))

# quick sanity check
table(subtype_meta$new_celltypes, subtype_meta$genotype)
table(subtype_meta$genotype, subtype_meta$stage)
```

# Bootstrap helper functions

- Identical pseudo-replicate logic to `08.1e-bootstrap-test-celltype-proportions-cell-cycle.Rmd`:
  sample with replacement within each genotype, then split evenly into
  `n_reps` pseudo-replicate groups.

```{r bootstrap-helpers}
assign_pseudo_replicates_genotype <- function(meta_subset, n_reps, genotypes) {

  pseudo_rep_col <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta_subset))

  for (geno in genotypes) {

    idx <- which(meta_subset$genotype == geno)

    if (length(idx) < n_reps) {
      warning(glue::glue(
        "Fewer than {n_reps} cells for genotype {geno} — skipping this group in this bootstrap."
      ))
      next
    }

    sampled_idx <- sample(idx, size = length(idx), replace = TRUE)

    n_keep      <- floor(length(sampled_idx) / n_reps) * n_reps
    sampled_idx <- sampled_idx[seq_len(n_keep)]
    rep_labels  <- rep(
      paste0(geno, "_rep", seq_len(n_reps)),
      each = floor(length(sampled_idx) / n_reps)
    )

    pseudo_rep_col[sampled_idx] <- rep_labels
  }

  return(pseudo_rep_col)
}

# runs the full 100-bootstrap propeller loop for one `clusters` vector against
# genotype, given a (already stage-filtered, if relevant) metadata data frame
run_bootstrap_propeller <- function(meta, cluster_col, n_bootstraps = 100, n_pseudoreps = 3) {

  genotypes <- levels(droplevels(meta$genotype))
  meta_sub  <- meta %>%
    dplyr::select(barcode, genotype, cluster = dplyr::all_of(cluster_col)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cluster = factor(cluster))

  raw_boot_list <- vector("list", n_bootstraps)

  for (b in seq_len(n_bootstraps)) {

    pseudo_reps <- assign_pseudo_replicates_genotype(
      meta_subset = meta_sub,
      n_reps      = n_pseudoreps,
      genotypes   = genotypes
    )

    meta_boot <- meta_sub %>%
      dplyr::mutate(pseudo_rep = pseudo_reps) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(pseudo_rep))

    if (nrow(meta_boot) < (n_pseudoreps * length(genotypes))) {
      raw_boot_list[[b]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    prop_result <- tryCatch(
      {
        speckle::propeller(
          clusters  = meta_boot$cluster,
          sample    = meta_boot$pseudo_rep,
          group     = meta_boot$genotype,
          transform = "asin"
        )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        message(glue::glue("    Bootstrap {b} failed: {conditionMessage(e)}"))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (!is.null(prop_result)) {
      prop_result$bootstrap_id <- b
    }

    raw_boot_list[[b]] <- prop_result
  }

  raw_results_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), raw_boot_list))

  summary_df <- raw_results_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(BaselineProp.clusters) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_bootstraps_run       = dplyr::n(),
      n_bootstraps_sig_fdr05 = sum(FDR < 0.05,  na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_sig_fdr05         = mean(FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_FDR             = median(FDR,       na.rm = TRUE),
      median_PropRatio       = median(PropRatio, na.rm = TRUE),
      CI_PropRatio_lower     = quantile(PropRatio, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      CI_PropRatio_upper     = quantile(PropRatio, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(prop_sig_fdr05))

  list(raw_results = raw_results_df, summary = summary_df)
}

# shared plot builder — one halfeye distribution per subtype, log2(PropRatio)
# PropRatio is Mib1_KO / control (see genotype factor levels above), so
# positive values = more of that subtype in the KO. fill_values is a named
# colour vector keyed by subtype (endocardial_cols or mesenchyme_cols).
make_subtype_bootstrap_plot <- function(raw_results, title, fill_values, outlier_fence = 3) {

  n_before <- nrow(raw_results)

  # rare pseudo-replicate draws can land a subtype at ~0 cells in one group,
  # giving a PropRatio that is either non-finite (0 or Inf) or technically
  # finite but astronomically large (e.g. 1e15) because the denominator
  # landed near, not at, zero. Either way these don't reflect the real
  # bootstrap distribution and just stretch the axis with invisible mass, so
  # drop non-finite draws, then drop per-subtype outliers using a Tukey
  # "far out" fence (median ± outlier_fence * IQR) on the log2 scale.
  raw_results <- raw_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(log2PR = log2(PropRatio)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2PR)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(BaselineProp.clusters) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      q1  = quantile(log2PR, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3  = quantile(log2PR, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q3 - q1
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      iqr == 0 | dplyr::between(log2PR, q1 - outlier_fence * iqr, q3 + outlier_fence * iqr)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-q1, -q3, -iqr, -log2PR)

  n_dropped <- n_before - nrow(raw_results)
  if (n_dropped > 0) {
    message(glue::glue(
      "{title}: dropped {n_dropped} bootstrap draw(s) (non-finite or extreme outlier) before plotting"
    ))
  }

  raw_results <- raw_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(BaselineProp.clusters = forcats::fct_reorder(
      BaselineProp.clusters, PropRatio, .fun = median
    ))

  ggplot(
    raw_results,
    aes(x = log2(PropRatio), y = BaselineProp.clusters, fill = BaselineProp.clusters)
  ) +
    ggdist::stat_halfeye(
      adjust        = 0.7,
      width         = 0.6,
      justification = -0.2,
      .width        = c(0.5, 0.95),
      point_colour  = NA,
      alpha         = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values, guide = "none") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = expression(Log[2]~"Proportion Ratio (Mib1 KO / Control), 100 bootstraps"),
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

# =============================================================================
# Bootstrap propeller: Endocardial subtype proportions
# Testing: Mib1-KO vs control, combined stages (e11 + e12 pooled)
# =============================================================================

```{r bootstrap-endocardial-combined, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
endocardial_meta <- subtype_meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(new_celltypes == "Endocardium")

table(endocardial_meta$endocardial_subtype, endocardial_meta$genotype)

endocardial_combined <- run_bootstrap_propeller(
  meta        = endocardial_meta,
  cluster_col = "endocardial_subtype"
)

endocardial_combined$summary

saveRDS(
  endocardial_combined,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "bootstrap_propeller_endocardial_subtype_combined.rds")
)

p_endocardial_combined <- make_subtype_bootstrap_plot(
  endocardial_combined$raw_results,
  title = "Endocardial subtype proportions — Mib1-KO vs control (e11 + e12 combined)",
  fill_values = endocardial_cols
)

ggsave(
  plot     = p_endocardial_combined,
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "bootstrap_endocardial_subtype_combined.png"),
  width = 9.5, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
  plot     = p_endocardial_combined,
  filename = file.path(deck_dir, "16-bootstrap_endocardial_subtype_combined.png"),
  width = 9.5, height = 5, dpi = 300
)

p_endocardial_combined
```

# =============================================================================
# Bootstrap propeller: Endocardial subtype proportions, split by stage
# Testing: Mib1-KO vs control, separately within e11 and e12
#
# Valid follow-up to the combined test above: subtype labels and the FDG
# embedding were both built on the full merged object, so subsetting by
# stage afterwards only changes which cells feed the proportions test, not
# the labels themselves. e11 (n = 6,575) and e12 (n = 8,056) are both large
# enough for the same pseudo-replicate design used elsewhere in this project.
# =============================================================================

```{r bootstrap-endocardial-by-stage, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
stages <- unique(subtype_meta$stage)
stage_labels <- c(e11 = "E11", e12 = "E12")

endocardial_by_stage <- setNames(
  lapply(stages, function(stg) {
    message(glue::glue("--- Endocardial subtypes, stage: {stg} ---"))
    run_bootstrap_propeller(
      meta        = dplyr::filter(endocardial_meta, stage == stg),
      cluster_col = "endocardial_subtype"
    )
  }),
  stages
)

purrr::walk(stages, function(stg) print(endocardial_by_stage[[stg]]$summary))

saveRDS(
  endocardial_by_stage,
  file = file.path(out_dir, "bootstrap_propeller_endocardial_subtype_by_stage.rds")
)

# single faceted plot (shared x-axis, consistent category order across both
# panels) rather than two separately-scaled plots stacked vertically -
# matches the side-by-side E11/E12 style used for the combined 13-category
# plot in 16-propeller_celltype_subtype_breakdown.Rmd
endo_raw_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(stages, function(stg) {
    endocardial_by_stage[[stg]]$raw_results %>% dplyr::mutate(stage = stage_labels[[stg]])
  })
)

endo_cat_order <- endo_raw_combined %>%
  dplyr::group_by(BaselineProp.clusters) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(med = median(PropRatio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(med) %>%
  dplyr::pull(BaselineProp.clusters)

outlier_fence <- 3
endo_raw_filtered <- endo_raw_combined %>%
  dplyr::mutate(log2PR = log2(PropRatio)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2PR)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(stage, BaselineProp.clusters) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    q1  = quantile(log2PR, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3  = quantile(log2PR, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = q3 - q1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(iqr == 0 | dplyr::between(log2PR, q1 - outlier_fence * iqr, q3 + outlier_fence * iqr)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(BaselineProp.clusters = factor(BaselineProp.clusters, levels = endo_cat_order))

p_endocardial_by_stage <- ggplot(endo_raw_filtered, aes(x = log2(PropRatio), y = BaselineProp.clusters, fill = BaselineProp.clusters)) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(adjust = 0.7, width = 0.6, justification = -0.2, .width = c(0.5, 0.95), point_colour = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = endocardial_cols, guide = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~stage, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Endocardial subtype proportions — Mib1-KO vs control",
    x     = expression(Log[2]~"Proportion Ratio (Mib1 KO / Control), 100 bootstraps"),
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

ggsave(
  plot     = p_endocardial_by_stage,
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "bootstrap_endocardial_subtype_by_stage.png"),
  width = 13, height = 7, dpi = 300
)
ggsave(
  plot     = p_endocardial_by_stage,
  filename = file.path(deck_dir, "16-bootstrap_endocardial_subtype_by_stage.png"),
  width = 13, height = 7, dpi = 300
)

p_endocardial_by_stage
```
